_README: Per-card review status, consumed by tools/card_coverage.py.
The index's default inference — 'this card appeared in a game a reviewer
read, therefore it is checked' — OVER-CREDITS in three ways, and this
file is how a reviewer corrects it:
1. A reviewer does not check every card in a game. Only the ones named
in the prompt, plus whatever they trip over.
2. A card can be present all game with its relevant ability never
firing (Mutavault played as a land and never animated; Grim Haruspex
out while nothing died). Nothing was verified.
3. A card FIXED in the same session was reviewed against logs that
PREDATE the fix. The corpus shows the broken behaviour, so the fix
itself is unverified until a fresh batch runs.
Statuses:
verified   - live evidence, in a corpus at or after `since_sha`, that
the card behaved per its printed text. Retired from the
pool. Include what was checked, because 'I saw the tag' is
not the same as 'I verified the semantics'.
unexercised- present in a reviewed game but the ability in question
never fired. STAYS in the pool.
awaiting   - a fix landed AFTER the corpus that was reviewed. STAYS in
the pool until a batch at or after `since_sha` is read.
Keys are lowercase card names, matching data/card_data_cache.json.

akroma, angel of wrath.note: In replacement_chain's coverage list, never drawn.

anger of the gods.note: [REPLACEMENT] exile-instead registered at resolution on two separate turns, correctly turn-clamped.

angrath's marauders.note: x2 on its controller's sources and correctly controller-GATED - the opponent's damage back was undoubled.

archon of sun's grace.note: Static grant registered; constellation never had an enchantment enter after it.

arlinn kord.note: Reviewer C: [0] created the 2/2 Wolf AND transformed her to Arlinn, Embraced by the Moon. The back face is reachable.

avacyn, angel of hope.note: Not in the corpus at all.

bant panorama.note: Played, and correctly refused its sac-search with no mana - but the search itself never ran.

battlefield forge.note: [MANA-DAMAGE] dealt 1 to its controller on each colored tap.

bloodline keeper.note: Cast, cost-reduced, activated, token entered and attacked - but the token's FLYING was never tested (no untapped blockers).

boros signet.note: Same as Battlefield Forge - the tap is invisible in the logs.

captivating vampire.note: Its own P/T is correct and its ANTHEM was the subject of a fix, but the control-stealing tap ability was never activated.

cast down.note: Correctly REFUSED a legendary target (Kambal) - 'doesn't have required type'. The nonlegendary exclusion is live.

charcoal diamond.note: Entered tapped correctly; the mana ability was never activated.

crypt of agadeem.note: Entered tapped correctly in two games; the {2},{T} scaling ability was never activated, so the arithmetic is untested.

dark depths.note: In test_snow_jorn but never drawn. Its generic enters-with-counters parse is the only live consumer besides Astral Cornucopia.

desecrated tomb.note: C4 live and DECISIVE: 2 cards left Qwen's graveyard, fired x1, exactly ONE Bat (the 2018-07-13 ruling). The Bat flew and connected.

domri, anarch of bolas.note: Reviewer C: [+1] added exactly ONE mana on both activations (never both colors); static +1/+0 scoped to its own controller.

elesh norn, grand cenobite.note: Both halves, correct sign and scope, and she excludes herself.

elspeth's nightmare.note: All three chapters plus the CR 704.5s sacrifice.

embercleave.note: ETB attach template resolved and equipped a real creature.

faerie guidemother.note: Reviewer A: single target, exactly +2/+1, flying granted, effect expired on schedule.

full moon's rise.note: Reviewer C: cast but COUNTERED before resolution, so its Werewolf-only anthem never registered.

furnace of rath.note: Correctly symmetric; the caster's own Comet Storm was doubled against himself. The May-30 house-rule removal stayed fixed.

gatekeeper of malakir.note: Kicker intervening-if correct on both a hand cast and a reanimated entry; entered tapped under Authority of the Consuls.

glacial chasm.note: Reviewer C, all four clauses: ETB land sacrifice, cumulative upkeep paid 2/4/6/8/10 then DECLINED at 12 and sacrificed, attacks refused while it was out, damage prevented.

goblin bombardment.note: Resolved inline x4 with real sacrifice costs and never reached Tier 3 - the fix that prevented the fabricated destroy.

goblin rabblemaster.note: [COMBAT-BEGIN-TRIGGER] resolved the token half INLINE (no Tier-3 call); no phantom extra attacker and no team pump.

gravecrawler.note: Cast and attacked at printed power; never in a graveyard, so cast-from-graveyard is untested.

grim haruspex.note: Cast and attacked in two games; no nontoken creature its controller owned died while it was out, so the draw trigger never fired.

heart's desire.note: [ADVENTURE-TEMPLATE] created a nameless 1/1 white Human token (previously named after the adventure).

hypnotic sprite.note: Creature half verified; Mesmeric Glare (the adventure half) was never cast.

icebreaker kraken.note: [ETB-TEMPLATE] resolved with the honest 'no tap - the card doesn't tap them' message; affinity and snow-spend both applied.

ill-tempered loner.note: Now reaches the unhandled queue, but its damage-back effect still has no deterministic branch.

insult // injury.note: Both halves; aftermath zone gate correct in BOTH directions (rejected from hand, cast from graveyard); two-target split resolved. Its invisibility to MASS damage is the mass-damage handler's defect, not this card's.

killing wave.note: The cross-game dedupe that cancelled it was fixed after the corpus.

kozilek, the broken reality.note: Combat damage and graveyard return resolved correctly.

magus of the coffers.note: Both activation refusals were correct; the scaling arithmetic is untested.

mesmeric orb.note: In test_escape_kroxa, drawn but never resolved (rejected for mana).

mutavault.note: Played as a land; the {1} animation was never offered or activated. The manland behavioural signal is absent, not disproven.

narfi, betrayer king.note: Registered a MULTI-subtype qualifier anthem ('other snows and zombies you control +1/+1') - the shape that previously registered nothing.

phyrexian negator.note: [DAMAGED-TRIGGER] sacrificed exactly as many permanents as damage taken, twice, attributed to the right controller.

reanimate.note: Reviewers C and D: the DECLARED graveyard target came back and the controller lost life equal to its REAL mana value (1 for Gravecrawler, 2 for Bloodghast).

reaper from the abyss.note: Morbid intervening-if correctly declined on five separate end steps (CR 603.4).

reckless waif.note: Full classic werewolf cycle: transformed, back face declined correctly on later upkeeps, attacked at back-face P/T.

sengir vampire.note: Dies-trigger premise gate correct five times. Its 4 damage failing to kill was Selfless Spirit's indestructible, not a defect - the reviewer's closest false positive.

sheoldred, the apocalypse.note: [DRAW-TRIGGER] drained the opponent 2 on their draw; cost reduction from Jet Medallion also applied.

shepherd of the flock.note: Adventure cost selection exemplary - creature half failed for mana, adventure cost used instead, exile tracked, creature half re-offered. Printed-target width is a separate MINOR.

silverflame squire.note: Reviewer A: creature side never cast, adventure never attempted.

sunforger.note: Cast and resolved as equipment; never ACTIVATED, so the unattach-cost fix is still untested.

sword of light and shadow.note: New template: gain 3 life + return a creature card from your graveyard. Did not connect this batch.

syr konrad, the grim.note: C4 live: 1 creature card left, fires x1 UN-consolidated (per-object). No N>1 case appeared; the unit pin covers it.

talisman of impulse.note: Reviewer C: dealt exactly 1 damage on each colored tap. The {C} half was not separately attributable.

tendershoot dryad.note: Subtype anthem registered ('saprolings you control +2/+2'); [ASCEND] city's blessing awarded at ten permanents.

tormod, the desecrator.note: C4 live: Faithless Looting flashed out of Rick's graveyard, 1 departure, fires x1 (consolidated), one Zombie token.

underworld sentinel.note: Attack trigger exiled a creature card from the graveyard with the dies-trigger link. The apparent self-exile was a Feldon TOKEN attacking while the real card was the exiled object.

usher to safety.note: Loaded as an adventure half only, never cast.

vile entomber.note: ETB tutor to the correct zone (graveyard, not hand); deathtouch body present.

xenagos, the reveler.note: Proposed and rejected for mana, never resolved.

drana, liberator of malakir.note: Her first-strike 'deals combat damage' trigger landed AFTER the regular step had already dealt un-pumped damage (CR 510.4). The drain now runs once per damage step.

boar umbra.note: Totem armor never saved a creature enchanted by an OPPONENT's Aura - both helpers scanned only the creature controller's battlefield. Now searches every battlefield; the Aura dies to its own owner's graveyard.

dissipate.note: Shared the plain _counter_action, so its 'exile it instead' clause was dropped and the countered spell went to the graveyard. Dedicated generator now sets countered_to=exile.

dissolve.note: Same class, found by sweeping the COUNTERSPELLS list: its Scry 1 was dropped. Dedicated generator now emits it.

setessan champion.note: Compound constellation resolved as draw-only; the +1/+1 counter clause was dropped across 9 fires. The watcher now emits both.

animating faerie.note: Its adventure half could never escalate to Tier 3 - the gate read `if not adv_msgs` while Tier 2 had already filled that list with a 'complex effect, escalating' placeholder. Cast three times, effect never happened.

mask of memory.note: New equipment combat-damage template (draw two, discard one). It connected 5 times this batch and resolved nothing.

sword of fire and ice.note: New template: 2 damage + draw a card.

sword of feast and famine.note: New template: opponent discards, untap all your lands (count derived from the board).

sword of sinew and steel.note: New template: destroy up to one opponent planeswalker and one artifact.
